'''''Galium minutulum''''' is a species of plant in the family [[Rubiaceae]]. It is native to [[Spain]], [[Portugal]], [[France]] and [[Italy]]. Some of the Italian collections are located on the island of [[Sardinia]], others inside [[Arcipelago Toscano National Park]], located on a chain of islands off the coast of [[Tuscany]].<ref>[http://apps.kew.org/wcsp/namedetail.do?name_id=86826 Kew World Checklist of Selected Plant Families, ''Galium minutulum'' ]</ref><ref>[http://luirig.altervista.org/flora/taxa/index1.php?scientific-name=galium+minutulum Altervista Flora Italiana, Caglio minuscolo]</ref> Many of the French populations are on the [[Hyères Islands]] in [[Provence]].<ref>[http://www.tandfonline.com/doi/abs/10.1080/12538078.2000.10515847#.U2zq8yi9Y-o Médail, F. et al. 2000. Biologie et écologie du gaillet nain (Galium minutulum Jordan, Rubiaceae) sur les îles d'Hyères (Var, France); implications pour la conservation de l'espèce. Acta Botanica Gallica: Botany Letters 147(3):]</ref>

''Galium minutulum'' is a diminutive plant, rarely more than 10 cm tall, and usually trailing along the ground. Flowers are generally less than 1 mm in diameter.<ref>[http://www.florealpes.com/fiche_galiumminutulum.php Flores Alpes, Gaillet minuscule]</ref><ref>Claude Thomas Alexis Jordan. 1846.  Observations sur Plusieurs Plantes Nouvelles 3: 182.</ref>
